category: debrid resale - Brazilian account shop (price by variant, not published until selection)

per_object_cap.stated: not applicable to the resale: the single-object cap is the debrid vendor's, not the shop's

retention.stated: not applicable to the resale: cached-item retention is the debrid vendor's

interface_detail: the shop delivers a voucher code or a login by email; the capacity itself is reached through the debrid vendor's REST API
tooling: any client that takes the vendor's API key: rclone, JDownloader, Stremio/Torrentio, pyload
chaining: a resold voucher only changes how the days are paid for; the stack above it is unchanged
binding_note: The shop is one of the three Brazilian fronts selling the same account shape; nothing about its price can be compared because it publishes none until checkout.
confidence_note: the seller's page was read today; a seller is not the vendor, so nothing here is at the documented rung except the vendor terms quoted in evidence

free_tier.stated: No free tier. 'Conta Premium Real-debrid ( Oficial )' with a duration selector of 30 days / 90 days / 1 year; no price is printed until a variant is chosen, so no number was readable.
free_tier.notes: rated '5.00 de 5' from 1 customer review on the page

egress.terms: no byte allowance published; 'Envio automático para acesso imediato, segundos após confirmaçao do pagamento'

limits.value: price visible only after choosing a duration; one review is the entire rating base

identity_cost.detail: Brazilian checkout, WhatsApp support, automatic delivery after payment confirmation

reliability_note: A single five-star review and a hidden price are the two weakest signals in the Brazilian set.

evidence.proved: the 30/90/365-day selector, the 5.00/5 rating from 1 review, and the absence of any printed price

notes: A dash is the finding: the duration selector exists but the page prints no price, so a buyer cannot compare it before checkout. The product is otherwise the contasvip shape.
